intro: Whitestone Oak Lumber is a sturdy crafting timber sourced from the subterranean shipyards beneath Moonbrook. Prized for its strength, it serves as a critical shaft material for sacred armaments forged by Alliance master smiths.

p: Found deep inside the labyrinthine Deadmines of Westfall, Whitestone Oak is shaped by Goblin Woodcarvers constructing the Defias Brotherhood's clandestine war fleet. Its dense, resilient grain makes it ideally suited to bear structural strain and high-impact wear, drawing the interest of seasoned armorers who require more than common ash or pine for ceremonial and martial craft.
